Kiran Shah
Senior Data Analyst | Ahmedabad
kiran.shah465@example.com | +91 9418326730

Data-focused analyst with a track record of turning complex datasets into actionable business insights across gaming, healthcare, and energy domains. Comfortable building dashboards, automating reporting workflows, and collaborating with stakeholders to drive product and operational decisions. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 90 days.

- Partnered with product and operations teams using Agile practices and Confluence for sprint planning and documentation to prioritize analytics requests and close 90% of tickets within the sprint.

Data Analyst (Hybrid)

- Maintained Confluence-runbooks for analytics processes and participated in Agile ceremonies to align analytics deliverables with product roadmaps.
